_comment: Every port's approach, built by tools/build_map_data.gd (see _lay_approaches()): gate is its harbour gate (lon, lat), 38 dock units out from the port along its facing, where its lanes start and end and the ships' ways in and out of the marina begin; points runs from the gate out to its sea gate, where the open-sea routing takes over, and is the first stretch of every lane the port has; nm is its length.

DLH.note: gate in TWH's marina disc (the two marinas would overlap at their biggest)

DUD.note: gate on the land as drawn; STRAIGHT to the nearest open water 0.5 degrees off (over whatever's between)

GIB.note: gate in TNG's marina disc (the two marinas would overlap at their biggest)
